title: AI Trading's Alpha Singularity: Emergent Market Reasoning through Agent-to-Agent Self-Evolution
central_strategy: A five-role, nine-client agent society proposes AlphaGen programs and evaluation metrics through role-scoped records and promotions, evolves skill libraries and per-round registries, relays selected signals into an incrementally trained MaskablePPO policy, and trades a dynamic CSI1000 universe from a top-30 alpha pool with five-day next-open execution.

preserved_components: Complete printed monotonicity_score_v1 and excess_drawdown_penalty_v1 metric programs execute deterministically.
Published target, temporal split, top-30/decile portfolio shell, five-day rebalance, and next-open timing are identifiable in prose.
Several baseline and PPO configuration values are documented.
required_but_missing: The dynamic CSI1000/RiceQuant snapshot, memberships, OHLCV/VWAP, trading masks, and immutable date arrays.
All role prompts, nine-client model snapshots and calls, skill stores, per-round registries, rejected trials, and promotion histories.
The 94 AlphaGen programs, their scores and factor panels, source-selected top-30 pool, signs, and combination records.
PPO environments, 15,000-step trajectories, checkpoints, policy actions, and relay state.
Backtester, weights, orders, fills, daily returns, baseline outputs, full seeds, table arrays, figure arrays, and result generator.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_metric_programs_are_not_a_strategy: The two complete listings score already-supplied alpha predictions or drawdowns; they do not generate an alpha score, select the top-30 pool, or emit a trading action.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_portfolio_shell_is_insufficient: Top-30 selection, deciles, and next-open timing require the missing 94 alpha programs, factor values, pool signs, and PPO relay. The shell has no signal to rank.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_jkp_cannot_fill_the_gap: JKP supplies a monthly U.S. universe and returns but cannot infer the missing AlphaGen programs or trained PPO actions. Substituting generic JKP factors would bypass agent-to-agent search and self-evolution.
monthly_jkp_assessment.release_claim_conflict: The contribution section says implementation, baselines, leakage audit, and registries are released, while Appendix A.8 says the release will include them; neither source contains a repository URL.
monthly_jkp_assessment.result_consistency_boundary: Multiple printed values conflict, including per-alpha summaries and increasing long-short returns at higher stated costs, so aggregate exhibits cannot replace the missing raw paths.

closure_rule: Do not promote metric programs, portfolio-shell prose, unaffiliated later repositories, or generic JKP factors to AGORA. Reopen for attributable registries/alpha programs, PPO checkpoints/actions, or complete experiment lineage.
